interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Write the disabled-model list to your settings file. The model drop-down picks it up the next time you select a dataset.

interactive.label: Revert
interactive.tooltip: Discard every change made since the last save (asks first).

interactive.label: Rescan
interactive.tooltip: Read the experiment registry again, in the background.

interactive.label: Drop stale
interactive.tooltip: Remove disabled entries that match no registered model (asks first).

interactive.label: Copy
interactive.tooltip: Copy the rows the table shows now, with the column headers, to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

interactive.label: Export CSV
interactive.tooltip: Write the rows and columns the table shows now to a CSV file.

interactive.label: Show disabled models
interactive.tooltip: Include switched-off models in the table.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the table, the Disabled switch and stale entries.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through picking a model, disabling it and saving.

interactive.label: Disabled
interactive.tooltip: Keep this model out of the model drop-down. It is not removed; nothing else changes. Matches on the display name, so a shared name switches off every experiment offering it.
